request: okay the next work is going to be the game version agnostiscm features for stuff like backports into the csdk10 and older versions of the game, it's going to need to be able to handle a ton of weird cases where someone needs to use a hero model from a version of the game with it's own vpks
findings: backport.client_build required game/citadel/pak01_dir.vpk and gameinfo.gi at an install root, so other build shapes were refused.
backport_package passed addon= to migrate_trees, which takes addon_name; the path had never run.
A mod's model path can be absent from an old build after heroes_staging/heroes_wip changes or folder renames.
fixes: client_build accepts install, game or game/citadel roots; collects every pack plus addons packs and skips chunks; gameinfo is optional.
find_client_model searches all pack trees, matches .vmdl to .vmdl_c, and falls back to the hero slug with staging/wip ordering.
Extraction uses the pack that holds the model; the manifest records pack, resolved path, requested path, exact flag and gameinfo.
Old source model resolution falls back to the mod's path, the client path, then the only vmdl; addon_name fixed.
Mods panel hint explains the search and the path-moved case.
evidence: tests/test_backport.py 8/8, including a patched end-to-end migration call.
limits: No real CSDK10 client extract was run.
CSDK10 compiler acceptance of newer cloth sections is unmeasured.
